interface.evidence: Original problem explicitly names TopModule, input in (255 bits), output out (8 bits).

semantics.function: out equals the number of binary one bits in in
semantics.timing: Combinational; output reflects current input after combinational settling, without cycle latency.
semantics.clock_reset: None: the original interface has only in and out.
semantics.initialization: No stored state or initialization requirement; test known inputs after settling.

verification.oracle: Independent testbench repeatedly shifts a copy of the original input and counts set least-significant bits using an integer.
verification.coverage: Zero, all ones, every one-hot and one-cold position, every count from 0 through 255, alternating patterns, random vectors and complements.
verification.sampling: Drive inputs then wait one simulation time unit before checking combinational output.
verification.failure_success: Case-inequality comparison with fatal on mismatch, bounded timeout, PASS only after all tests.

specification_ambiguities.resolution: No extra X/Z requirements inferred; functional verification uses binary inputs.
